content: openai-python types enum-like params as Union[str, Literal[...]] (e.g. model: Union[str, ChatModel]) explicitly to accept server-side enum growth while keeping IDE autocomplete. Empirically verified with mypy --strict (local run, 2026-08-18): Literal['bcba','nyse','nasdaq'] | str produces ZERO error on a typo'd argument -- the union collapses to str and all type safety is forfeited. A closed Literal DOES flag it (arg-type, 'incompatible type Literal[...]'). So the Union pattern buys autocomplete only, not typo protection.
